start.headline: How is enrollment really going?
start.body: Your dashboard answers that before your board asks.

steps.alt: The enrollment funnel from New Inquiry through Enrolled with conversion percentages
steps.title: See where families drop off
steps.body: The funnel shows how many families reach each stage, and what share move on to the next. You can spot the stage that needs work.

steps.alt: Dashboard tiles showing $416.5K tuition in pipeline and 46 families
steps.title: Tuition and families in the pipeline
steps.body: Two numbers every head of school wants: how much tuition is in play, and how many families are in it.

steps.alt: Chart of all families by status: open, won and lost
steps.title: Open, won and lost at a glance
steps.body: See how many families are still deciding, how many enrolled and how many chose elsewhere.

finish.headline: Real numbers, always up to date.
finish.body: No more pulling reports together the night before a board meeting.
